title: Digital Twins as Funhouse Mirrors: Five Key Distortions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the predictive accuracy of digital twins across different education and income levels using XGBoost and Partial Dependence Plots, demonstrating higher accuracy for more socioeconomically advantaged individuals (representation bias).

Comparing the aggregate opinions of digital twins versus their human counterparts on various policy issues, such as government regulation, taxation, and wealth redistribution, to identify systematic ideological shifts.

Evaluating stereotyping by comparing the predictions of full-persona digital twins against those generated using only demographic variables, showing an over-reliance on demographic characteristics rather than individual cognition.
